prompt_text: What is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City MO for someone who is self-employed?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” broker, but **BBS Insurance** looks like a strong local option to start with for a self-employed person in Kansas City, Missouri. It says it compares Marketplace and private plans across multiple carriers, checks subsidy eligibility, and serves Missouri residents from its North Kansas City office. **Call (816) 205-4664** or visit [bbs-insurance.com](https://bbs-insurance.com/).

Also worth comparing:

- **Apollo Insurance Group** — Lee’s Summit-based; says it helps individuals and families compare plans across carriers. **(816) 400-4477** · [apollo-insurance.com](https://apollo-insurance.com/)
- **AIS Health Advisors** — serves the KC metro and specifically mentions helping self-employed people navigate ACA Marketplace coverage and subsidies. **(913) 333-8627** · [aishealthadvisors.com](https://aishealthadvisors.com/)

When you call, ask whether the broker is licensed in **Missouri**, can compare **all relevant HealthCare.gov plans** in your ZIP code, and will check your doctors, prescriptions, and estimated income for subsidy eligibility. Broker help is generally available at no extra charge, but confirm how the broker is compensated and whether they’re showing you Marketplace plans, off-Marketplace plans, or both. You can also compare or enroll directly at [HealthCare.gov](https://www.healthcare.gov/).
